assessments.reasoning: The second sentence of condition 1 states both the product-use context and the voluntary nature of the acknowledgment.

challenge.method: Tested omission of a manual credit for a commercial product, then tested whether adding such a credit permits removing the notice from accompanying covered source.
challenge.results: The documentation sentence draws no commercial-use exception to its optional wording. Adding a manual credit leaves condition 3 applicable to accompanying covered source.

limitations: The express option concerns a product-documentation acknowledgment. Origin representations and notice preservation in distributed source remain subject to their respective conditions.
reasoning: Condition 1 expressly makes acknowledgment in the product documentation optional when a product uses the software.
